about: Nodes of the meteorology lineage graph, type "warning-service": who turns it into a warning. Ids are stable (incident.entities@ may adopt them); meaning is in the edges (meteorology/edges/), not here. Joins, each a fact we state and not a match: "entity" (this node is the same thing as that entity in entities/), "of" (a site node: the entity that publishes the site), "source" (the id in sources/registry.json of the same thing).

nodes.name: IPMA's weather warnings (avisos meteorológicos)
nodes.summary: Yellow, orange and red warnings by district and by hazard, issued by IPMA. The primary source of this site's headline.
